welcomeMessageBody:
Welcome to Chapter 3's Readiness Assessment.

I am going to guide you through a series of questions to help you understand how ready you are to begin exploring your next career chapter. Please base your responses based on how you feel today.

The process should take no more than 10-15 minutes and at the end you'll receive your readiness profile. Please note, there are no right or wrong answers.

If at any point you do not understand the question, please let me know.
